errors.evidence: This describes the orange line. The line shows a continuous increase over the three points. The description incorrectly states that it decreases in the final segment. The final value is also closer to 515,000, not 500,000.

errors.text_span: Тази линия започва на стойност 180000 в Година 1, достига до 220000 в Година 2 и след това намалява до 200000 в Година 3.
errors.evidence: This describes the blue line. The chart shows the blue line starting at ~160,000, dipping to ~140,000, and then rising to ~180,000. The description incorrectly states the trend is a peak in the middle, which is the opposite of the visual data.

errors.text_span: Тази линия започва на стойност 680000 в Година 1, достига до 700000 в Година 2 и след това намалява до 700000 в Година 3.
errors.evidence: This describes the gray line. The starting value is a significant underestimate (~730,000 in the figure vs. 680,000 in the description). The trend description is also incorrect; the line decreases from the first to the second point and then remains flat, whereas the text describes an increase followed by a decrease.

The description fails to mention what each colored line represents according to the legend. It does not map the blue line to "Печалба", the orange line to "Оборот", or the gray line to "Стойност на активите".
